Adaptations: static descriptor replaces kernel module registration; shared compressor
ABI uses ordinary contiguous buffers; EVP SHA1 replaces kernel shash API using
the existing static OpenSSL dependency; Linux ARC4 algorithm unchanged except
types, static linkage and unsigned loop indices; secure wipe replaces sensitive
free; bounds/options checked before reads; unsupported bits rejected; cryptographic
failures return fatal/drop status; master/session key debug output removed.
Original algorithm/state machines, rekey cadence, loss and reset behavior retained.
MPPE40/128 only, with upstream stateful/stateless handling. MPPC/56 unsupported.
The host must reject plaintext network packets while MPPE is required/active.
Linux ARC4 source is GPL-2.0-or-later; retain source and notices on redistribution.
